meta.location: The cavity of a rock, the valley of Gilgal, the plains of Heshlon
meta.date: The first years of the final war
meta.unit: Ether's prophecies and the war with Shared (Ether 13)
principles: Two cities kept apart by name
A record written from a hiding place
An offer with terms attached to a whole household

world_behind.title: Moroni marks this as the finish
world_behind.text: Verse 1 opens the last stretch of his account of this people. Ether 1:1 opened it and Ether 15:33 closes it, so the abridgment of the Jaredite record runs fifteen chapters and Moroni announces both ends of it in his own voice.

world_behind.title: Ether taught from the beginning of man
world_behind.text: Verse 2 has Ether teaching from the beginning of man, including what the land became after the waters receded. Ether 1:3 says Moroni is not writing the account from Adam because it stands on the plates of brass, so the range Ether covered is wider than the range that survives.

world_behind.title: He kept two cities apart
world_behind.text: Verse 5 separates the New Jerusalem from the Jerusalem Lehi left.

world_behind.title: Moroni is forbidden to write more
world_behind.text: Verse 13 stops him in the middle of Ether's prophecies. Ether 4:5 and 5:1 record the other prohibition he is under, the sealed portion he may not translate, and 3 Nephi 26:11 has his father stopped the same way. Both writers are told to stop at the same kind of material.

world_behind.title: The record was written at night from a rock
world_behind.text: Verses 13 and 14 have Ether hide by day and watch by night.

world_behind.title: The offer to Coriantumr covered his household
world_behind.text: Verses 20 and 21 set repentance for Coriantumr and all his house against the loss of everyone but him. Ether 15:29 to 32 reports the terms being met exactly, and Omni 1:21 has him found alive by the people of Zarahemla, which closes a promise made two books earlier.

world_behind.title: A thigh wound took two years
world_behind.text: Verse 31 keeps Coriantumr off the field two years with a wound in the thigh. Ether 14:12 and 30 and Ether 15:9 and 27 record three more woundings of the same man, so the record tracks one body through four injuries and a war of extermination.

words.text: Drew back from ground it had covered. The word appears once in the record, here, and not at all in the King James Bible.
A holy place set apart. The record uses the word twice and the King James Bible a hundred and thirty-seven times. Verse 3 puts it beside the New Jerusalem.
Thrown into confusion, or put to shame. Treated at 1 Nephi 14:2. It appears eighteen times in the record and fifty in the King James Bible.
A hollow space. Treated at 1 Nephi 3:27. The record uses the word five times, four of them in this chapter, and never the King James Bible.
Nothing, or worth nothing. Treated at 1 Nephi 19:7. The record has it eighteen times, the King James Bible three.
The upper leg. It appears once in the record, here, and twenty-one times in the King James Bible.
To hold back by force. It appears twice in each record, and verse 31 says there was no one to do it.

phrases.term: After the waters had receded from off the face of this land
phrases.text: Where Ether started the account. The land's history begins at the flood.

phrases.term: The place of the New Jerusalem, which should come down out of heaven
phrases.text: What he said this land was for. Revelation 21:2 describes the same city descending.

phrases.term: It could not be a new Jerusalem for it had been in a time of old
phrases.text: The distinction drawn between the two cities. The old one is promised rebuilding under its own name.

phrases.term: For which things there has been a type
phrases.text: Moroni pointing at a pattern before he gives it. Verse 7 supplies it.

phrases.term: As Joseph brought his father down into the land of Egypt
phrases.text: The pattern itself. A father preserved then, a remnant preserved now.

phrases.term: Whose garments are white through the blood of the Lamb
phrases.text: The mark on those who dwell in the New Jerusalem. Verse 11 says the others were washed in the same blood.

phrases.term: I was about to write more, but I am forbidden
phrases.text: Moroni stopping himself at the edge of the subject. He reports the restriction and leaves it there.

phrases.term: He hid himself in the cavity of a rock by day
phrases.text: Where the prophet lived once he was cast out. Verse 14 says the record was made there.

phrases.term: Having studied, himself, in all the arts of war
phrases.text: Coriantumr's qualification, given as the reason he could answer them. The verse adds what he learned of the world's cunning.

phrases.term: Coriantumr should receive a burial by them
phrases.text: One line of the sentence passed on him. Omni 1:21 records the people who found him.

phrases.term: There was none to restrain them
phrases.text: The state of the land during the two years of his wound. Nothing in the verse suggests anyone tried.

verses.label: v. 1–3
verses.title: A whole prophetic career summarized, then itemized
verses.text: The record reports what was rejected before reporting the rejection's consequences: "he truly told them of all things, from the beginning of man." Then it lists three specifics, that the land became "a choice land above all other lands" after the waters receded, that all who dwell on it should serve God, and that it was "the place of the New Jerusalem." The summary claim is total and the itemized content is short, so the reader is told a great deal was said and given three points of it.

verses.label: v. 7
verses.title: A comparison built as a four-term proportion
verses.text: The record announces a type at verse 6 and then works it out: "as Joseph brought his father down into the land of Egypt, even so he died there; wherefore, the Lord brought a remnant of the seed of Joseph out of the land of Jerusalem." Both halves turn on a father and a removal, and the stated point of the comparison is mercy in preservation, "even as he was merciful unto the father of Joseph that he should perish not." The record supplies the pattern first and the interpretation second, which is the reverse of how it usually handles a figure.

chapter.title: The chapter puts prophecy first and war second
chapter.text: Verses 1 through 12 are doctrine and verses 15 through 31 are battles, with the rock between them.

chapter.title: Two cities are kept apart by name
chapter.text: Verse 5 refuses to call the old Jerusalem new and says what is promised to it instead.

chapter.title: A type is announced and then supplied
chapter.text: Verse 6 says there has been one and verse 7 gives it in a single sentence about Joseph.

chapter.title: Moroni stops himself
chapter.text: Verse 13 has him forbidden to write more, with the subject half finished.

chapter.title: The record comes out of a hiding place
chapter.text: Verse 14 has Ether write the remainder while watching the destruction by night.

chapter.title: The offer is generous and the alternative is total
chapter.text: Verse 20 puts the kingdom and the people on one side, and verse 21 leaves one man alive on the other.

chapter.title: Coriantumr's training is named
chapter.text: Verse 16 credits him with study in all the arts of war and all the cunning of the world.

chapter.title: One wound stops one man and nothing else
chapter.text: Verse 31 gives two years of bloodshed across the land with no one to restrain it.

applications.title: Give the whole frame, not only the warning
applications.text: Ether told them of all things from the beginning of man, what the land was and what it was for, and they rejected all of it. Refusing an entire account of your situation is a larger failure than refusing a rebuke.

applications.title: Keep two things apart when they share a name
applications.text: Ether took trouble over which Jerusalem he meant.

applications.title: Current order is not final order
applications.text: The scripture he cites has those who were first becoming last, and those who were last becoming first. Where you stand now is a caution or a comfort depending on where you are sitting.

applications.title: Stop when you are told to stop
applications.text: Moroni had more to write and left it unwritten.

applications.title: Work from where you are
applications.text: Ether wrote the remainder of this record out of a hole in a rock.

applications.title: The list of who would not repent keeps widening
applications.text: Not Coriantumr, nor his sons and daughters, nor those of Cohor, nor those of Corihor, and at last none upon the face of the whole earth. Adding one clause at a time is how the record shows there was no longer anybody to appeal to.

applications.title: Take the offer while it stands
applications.text: The terms given to Coriantumr covered his household and his whole people.

applications.title: Two years out of the fight changed nothing
applications.text: Coriantumr's wound kept him from battle for two years, and the record says the whole land went on shedding blood with none to restrain them. Pulling the leader out of a conflict does not stop one that has become its own engine.

questions.text: What have I been told about the ground I stand on?
Where am I confusing two things because they share a name?
What have I been told to leave unsaid?
What can I still do from where I am?
What am I skilled at that I have aimed at the wrong thing?
What offer is open to me right now?
Where is there no one to restrain me?
